data.name: 零氪超变
data.detailed_description:
Game Introduction of Zero Pay Super Evolution

Zero Pay Super Evolution is a Chinese-style idle cat management game featuring cash-free casual street stall gameplay, tailor-made for free-to-play players to run a thriving snack business without any in-app purchases.

Core Management Gameplay

Play as an adorable cat vendor selling traditional Tongguan snacks such as roujiamo and spicy pepper soup. Stoves automatically churn out food without constant manual control, and you can keep earning gold coins even when offline. Feline customers line up automatically to buy your food, letting you collect paw-shaped gold coins and expand your entire snack street step by step.

Spend gold coins to upgrade stoves and boost firepower, which cuts food production time, greatly speeds up serving efficiency, and raises profit per serving — the longer you run your stalls, the faster your earnings grow.

Healing Chinese-Style Cat World

All kinds of fluffy cats come to visit, including orange tabbies, gray cats, blue cats and more, each with unique funny dialogue. The scene is decorated with ancient Chinese city gates, red lanterns and traditional shop signs, paired with soft, fresh hand-drawn art. The relaxing, heartwarming vibe lets you play for hours without fatigue.
